newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's VEW expects moderate profit rise in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Germany's VEW expects moderate profit rise in 1996.

text.p: Germany electricity group VEW AG said on Monday that it expected a moderate rise in net profits in full year 1996 and for earnings at the parent holding company to stay around current levels.
The group said its 1996 earnings would allow it to pay an "appropriate" dividend, an expression which VEW has on previous occasions used when it planned to keep the dividend unchanged.

"We expect to show a profit for 1996 which will allow us to give a good return on share capital as well as allowing the necessary strengthening of reserves," VEW said in a letter to shareholders, published on Monday.
In 1995 VEW paid out a dividend of nine marks.
